item.title: Job Application Tracker: Job Hunting Without the Chaos (Before & After)
item.description: Before: 40 open tabs, three half-used spreadsheets, forgotten follow-ups and the same resume for every job. After: one application pipeline, follow-ups with due dates, interviews and contacts saved, and AI prompts to tailor each resume. That's what AI Job Search Tracker does, right in your browser. Tap to get organized.
